👤 Qiyuan Hu, Kartiek Agarwal, Ivar Martin
arXiv:2609.28726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generalize the canonical Hopfield model of associative memory, which stores classical states of individual spins, to store entangled quantum states.
